init_process_group: initialize a distributed process group with backend, init_method, timeout, world_size, and rank parameters
create_process_group_subgroup: create a new distributed process group subgroup with specified ranks, timeout, and backend options
run_all_reduce_collective: run an all_reduce collective operation to sum tensor data across all processes in a group
run_all_gather_collective: run an all_gather collective operation to gather tensors from all processes into a list
run_barrier_synchronization: run a barrier synchronization to block all processes until the whole group enters the function
